cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft MSHTML Framework Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft MSHTML Framework contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DNR-322L Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link DNR-322L contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS level commands on the device. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Juniper Junos OS EX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution, which would allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine. This could be exploited without authentication.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Fortinet FortiWeb SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized SQL code or commands via crafted HTTP or HTTPs requests.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Dante Discovery Process Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/59673137c45ac2bcfad1170d954347c1a17ab949 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-31125

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Fortinet FortiOS Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Fortinet FortiOS contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to cipher sensitive data in FortiOS configuration backup file via knowledge of the hard-coded key.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a spoofing vulnerability that has a high impact to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center contain a remote code execution vulnerability resulting from a pdkinstall development plugin being incorrectly enabled in release builds.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Langflow Origin Validation Error Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Langflow contains an origin validation error vulnerability in which an overly permissive CORS configuration combined with a refresh token cookie configured as SameSite=None allows a malicious webpage to perform cross-origin requests that include credentials and successfully call the refresh endpoint. This could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and achieve full system compromise via obtained tokens that permit access to authenticated endpoints.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability could affect an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow ; https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/releases/tag/v1.9.3; https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/issues/11465#event-25774545848 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-34291

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SonicWall SMA1000 Missing Authorization Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SonicWall SMA1000 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation appliance management console (AMC) of affected devices.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Check for signs of potential compromise on all internet accessible SonicWall SMA1000 instances after applying mitigations. For more information please see: https://psirt.global.sonicwall.com/vuln-detail/SNWLID-2025-0019 ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-40602

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability allows for memory corruption due to unauthorized command execution in GPU micronode while executing specific sequence of commands.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
cisa_kev_entries.notes: Please check with specific vendors (OEMs,) for information on patching status. For more information, please see: https://docs.qualcomm.com/product/publicresources/securitybulletin/june-2025-bulletin.html ;   https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-21479

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Acclaim Systems USAHERDS Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Acclaim Systems USAHERDS contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to achieve remote code execution on the system that runs the application. The MachineKey must be obtained via a separate vulnerability or other channel.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Please contact the product developer for support and vulnerability mitigation.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Array Networks ArrayOS AG OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Array Networks ArrayOS AG contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Srimax Output Messenger Directory Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Srimax Output Messenger contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to access sensitive files outside the intended directory, potentially leading to configuration leakage or arbitrary file access.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and the execution of arbitrary commands using shell metacharacters in the statusfile property.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.product: IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS and XE Software Internet Key Exchange Memory Leak Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in the implementation of Internet Key Exchange Version 1 (IKEv1) functionality in Cisco IOS Software and Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause an affected device to reload, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Aviatrix Controller Unrestricted Upload of File
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type is possible, which allows an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code via directory traversal.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Race Condition Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability that allows a local attacker with low-level privileges to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could enable the attacker to gain SYSTEM-level access.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows DWM Core Library Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows DWM Core Library contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Citrix ShareFile Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Improper Access Control in Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller may allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise the storage zones controller.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager contains an improper verification of source of a communication channel vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending specially crafted packets.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple iOS Memory Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Oracle BI Publisher Unauthorized Access Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Oracle BI Publisher, formerly XML Publisher, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for various unauthorized actions. Open-source reporting attributes this vulnerability to allowing for authentication bypass.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco IOS Software for Cisco Integrated Services Routers Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: A vulnerability in the implementation of a protocol in Cisco Integrated Services Routers Generation 2 (ISR G2) Routers running Cisco IOS could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to cause an affected device to reload, resulting in a denial of service.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Adobe Flash Player Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Adobe Flash Player have a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: LG N1A1 NAS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: LG N1A1 NAS 3718.510 is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows User Profile Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Crestron products are vulnerable to command injection via the file_transfer.cgi HTTP endpoint. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can use this vulnerability to execute operating system commands as root.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Adobe Flash Player Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Use-after-free vulnerability in the BitmapData class in the ActionScript 3 (AS3) implementation in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Local Security Authority (LSA) contains a spoofing vulnerability where an attacker can coerce the domain controller to authenticate to the attacker using NTLM.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply remediation actions outlined in CISA guidance [https://www.cisa.gov/guidance-applying-june-microsoft-patch].

Read CISA implementation guidance carefully before deploying to domain controllers.;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-26925

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chromium Network Service Use-After-Free Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Google Chromium Network Service contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: SAP NetWeaver SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: SQL injection vulnerability in the UDDI server in SAP NetWeaver J2EE Engine 7.40 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via unspecified vectors.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework Expression Language Injection Vulnerability

A remote, unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute malicious code using a chain of Java serialized objects via org.ajax4jsf.resource.UserResource$UriData.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ZK Framework AuUploader Unspecified Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Google Chromium V8 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways Information Disclosure Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Fortinet FortiOS Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple versions of Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Office Object Record Corruption Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Office contains an object record corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Excel file with a malformed record object.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Progress Kemp LoadMaster OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Progress Kemp LoadMaster contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system through the LoadMaster management interface, enabling arbitrary system command execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Android Pixel Information Disclosure Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Android Pixel contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the fastboot firmware used to support unlocking, flashing, and locking affected devices.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Code Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contains a code injection vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows CNG Key Isolation Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Cryptographic Next Generation (CNG) Key Isolation Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Adobe Flash Player ASLR Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Adobe Flash Player does not properly restrict discovery of memory addresses, which allows attackers to bypass the address space layout randomization (ASLR) protection mechanism.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Qualitia Active! Mail Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Qualitia Active! Mail contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary or trigger a denial-of-service via a specially crafted request.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Palo Alto Networks Expedition Missing Authentication Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to takeover an Expedition admin account and potentially access configuration secrets, credentials, and other data.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Streaming Service Untrusted Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Streaming Service contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DWL-2600AP Access Point Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link DWL-2600AP access point contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability via the Save Configuration functionality in the Web interface, using shell metacharacters in the admin.cgi?action=config_save configBackup or downloadServerip parameter.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply updates per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if updates are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Kernel TOCTOU Race Condition Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server Template Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server contain an unauthenticated OGNL template injection vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Zyxel Multiple NAS Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands remotely via a crafted HTTP request.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Apex One and Apex One as a Service
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Trend Micro Apex One and Apex One as a Service Improper Validation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Trend Micro Apex One and Apex One as a Service contain an improper validation of rollback mechanism components that could lead to remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Samsung Mobile Devices Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted CSF proxy requests.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DIR-820 Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link DIR-820 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ping_addr parameter to ping.ccp.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue utilization of the product.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Joomla! Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Joomla! contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to webservice endpoints.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Progress MOVEit Transfer contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to MOVEit Transfer's database. Depending on the database engine being used (MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or Azure SQL), an attacker may be able to infer information about the structure and contents of the database in addition to executing SQL statements that alter or delete database elements.

Additional information is available at: https://community.progress.com/s/article/MOVEit-Transfer-Critical-Vulnerability-31May2023.;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-34362

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Linux Kernel Time-of-Check Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Linux kernel contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

cisa_kev_entries.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. Please check with specific vendors for information on patching status. cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak sensitive information.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Progress WhatsUp Gold SQL Injection Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Qlik Sense Path Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Qlik Sense contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create an anonymous session by sending maliciously crafted HTTP requests. This anonymous session could allow the attacker to send further requests to unauthorized endpoints.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply remediations or mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if remediation or mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability within the n_tty_write function that allows local users to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) or gain privileges via read and write operations with long strings.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) contains an use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the underlying operating system and root-level persistence.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Citrix Session Recording Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Citrix Session Recording contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows limited remote code execution with privilege of a NetworkService Account access. Attacker must be an authenticated user on the same intranet as the session recording server.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Multiple Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers contains a command injection vulnerability in the web-based management interface. Successful exploitation could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to gain root-level privileges and access unauthorized data.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DownloadFileServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Remote Access Connection Manager contains a NULL pointer dereference that could allow an unauthorized attacker to deny service locally.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: PaperCut NG/MF Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: PaperCut NG/MF contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability, which, under specific conditions, could potentially enable an attacker to alter security settings or execute arbitrary code.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Apple iOS and iPadOS Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Apple iOS and iPadOS contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows a physical attacker to disable USB Restricted Mode on a locked device.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Windows Power Dependency Coordinator Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Power Dependency Coordinator contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to obtain SYSTEM privileges.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to webauth_operation.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Microsoft Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Remote Desktop Services, formerly known as Terminal Service, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to connect to the target system using RDP and send specially crafted requests. cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor Improper Access Control Vulnerability

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: Wing FTP Server Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Wing FTP Server contains an improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character vulnerability that can allow injection of arbitrary Lua code into user session files. This can be used to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the FTP service (root or SYSTEM by default).
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: 7-Zip contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the Mark-of-the-Web security feature to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.
cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: ServiceNow Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs Vulnerability

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

This vulnerability affects legacy D-Link products. cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.vulnerability_name: D-Link DIR-645 Router Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
cisa_kev_entries.short_description: D-Link DIR-645 Wired/Wireless Router allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a GetDeviceSettings action to the HNAP interface.

cisa_kev_entries.short_description: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability that may allow an attacker to achieve path traversal and remote code execution.

cisa_kev_entries.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

cisa_kev_entries.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
